to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

Credit rating system for small  and
medium scale enterprises
*21. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  he has launched the first
credit rating system  for small and medium
scale enterprises;
(b) if so, whether the move is aimed at
ensuring  higher availability of bank and
institutional credit to the small and medium
enterprises sector;
(c) whether the nodal agency for the
project would be the National Small
Industries Corporation; and
(d) if so, to what extent this rating
system has been helpful for the small and
medium enterprises?
Establishment of repair facilities
*22. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether as a pre-condition to
placement of orders for Boeing/Airbus,
India  has sought  foreign investment in
civil aviation sector by establishing repair
overhaul and maintenance facilities in India;
(b) whether Boeing Airplane Co. and
Airbus Industrie have committed to invest
around Rs. 1,000.00 crores on Indian
facilities for maintenance, repair and
overhaul of their aircrafts in India; and
(c) whether around 150 Boeing aircrafts
are expected to be inducted by the Indian
carriers over the next three years and if so,
whether  financial viability of establishing
an MRO venture in India has been
confirmed?
US's concern over Indo-Iran pipeline
project
†*23. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indo-Pak-Iran pipeline
project has reached the crucial stage now;
(b) whether  United States of America
has expressed its disagreement about the
said project;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether any talks have been held
between him and U.S. Secretary of State in
this regard; and
(e) if so, the outcome of talks?

Pench Mega Project in Chhindwara
†*24. SHRIMATI  MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the proposal
of  Pench Mega Project in Chhindwara
district of Madhya Pradesh is pending  with
the Central Water Commission for
approval/release of investment amount for
many years;
(b) if so, by when this scheme will be
approved; and
(c) whether this scheme  is getting aid
from Indo-German Bilateral Development
Co-operative through its various schemes?
Committee to advise in cases against
companies
*25. SHRIMATI JAYA BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of COMPANY AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
appointed a committee to aid and advise in
cases pending against 50,000 companies
for various violations;
(b) what kind of advice the committee
is expected to render; and
(c) whether any terms of reference have
been drawn up in this  regard and if so, the
details thereof?
Oil prices in international market
*26. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the rapidly increasing international oil
prices that have already touched the figure
of US$ 60 per barrel;
(b) whether the international oil prices
would further increase; and
(c) what steps Government propose to
take in this regard and whether there is
adequate oil reserve in the country to face
any eventuality?
Deduction  of TDS from hospitals/
nursing homes
†*27. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI JANARDAN
DWIVEDI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that deducting
TDS from the payment to be made  by big
hospitals/nursing homes in private sector
and coaching institutes to the doctors,
teachers and professors is compulsory;
(b) the details of such big hospitals/
nursing homes and coaching institutes
which either did not  deposit the same
even after deducting TDS or did not deduct
itself; and
(c)  the action Government are taking to
recover the amount of TDS from these
institutions?
Programme on improvement of oil
sector
*28. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that a
comprehensive 17-Point programme has
been drawn up to improve the performance
of the oil sector to achieve long term oil
security for the country; and

(b)  if so, the details thereof and the
present status of its implementation?
Delay in supply of gas cylinders in
Kerala
*29. SHRI  A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS  be pleased to state:
(a)  whether  public sector companies
reduced the distribution of number of refilled
cooking gas cylinders in various districts
of Kerala recently;
(b) if so, whether there was delay in
receiving refilled  cooking gas cylinders in
various districts of Kerala in June, 2005
and thereafter;
(c) the reasons  for the delay in receiving
refilled cooking gas cylinders;
(d) the action taken, if any, to avoid
delay; and
(e) the details including number of
refilled cooking gas cylinders distributed
for the last three years through various
public sector companies in Kerala, district-
wise, year-wise and category-wise?
Crop insurance scheme for Orissa
*30. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that crop
insurance companies are showing little
interest in Orissa resulting in a raw deal to
it;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
mandate of the National Agriculture
Insurance Scheme is to restore the
credibility of a farmer in the event of his
crop failure, whereas a vast majority of the
farming community in Orissa has been left
outside its ambit; and
(c) the action plan of Government to
make the National Agricultural Insurance
Scheme expand its coverage in Orissa?
Central assistance to augment
tourism to Karnataka
*31. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has sent a number of proposals
requesting for Central assistance to augment
tourism in the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that approval has
not yet been given by the Central
Government to these proposals;
(d) if so, the status of these proposals;
and
(e) by when these proposals will be
cleared?
Cleaning of rivers and lakes
†*32. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
 Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether  Government have
formulated any plan to cleanse the big rivers
and lakes of the country;
(b) if so, the names of the rivers identified
for this purpose and the quantum of
additional water likely to be made available
in the country due to this plan; and
(c) by when this scheme is likely to be
completed?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
9

Alternative energy sources
*33. SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS KAUR:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of the fast depleting
and drying  oil reserves, not only in India
but all over the world, India and China have
begun considering practical long term
proposals to diversify supply of energy
resources and to loosen the grip of oil
exporting nations on their growing
economics;
(b) whether Government have taken
stock of India's abundant alternative sources
of energy, in the form of hydroelectric power
potential, wind and water energy, natural
gas, N-energy;
(c) if so, the outcome thereof; and
(d) the new long term power policy, if
any, evolved?
Protection of sub-soil water
*34. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
salinisation of sub-soil water is taking place
in the coastal region and even in interior
areas;
(b) whether Government have assessed
the impact of this salinisation of sub-soil
water in the country;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the steps taken/proposed to be
taken by Government to protect sub-soil
water?
Discussion with Pakistan on pipeline
project
*35. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether he visited Pakistan in the
month  of May to discuss core issue of
import of LNG through  $4.16 billion Iran-
Pakistan-India gas pipeline project;
(b) if so, what is the outcome of
discussions held between two countries;
(c) what other steps were discussed and
agreements reached between the two
countries;
(d) whether he had also discussions
regarding route of pipeline and transit fee
with Pakistan; and
(e) if  so, whether on this issue also
final agreement has been reached?
Off-loading of shares of BHEL
*36. SHRI LALIT SURI : Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
decided to off-load 10 per cent of its share
in Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd.;
(b) if so, whether any share thereof has
been set aside for the employees and the
small investors; if so, the details thereof;
and
(c) the amount likely to be raised from
this sell off and how the proceeds would
be utilized?
10

Bio-diesel fund
*37. SHRI B.J. PANDA:
SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
 Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to allot Rs. 1400 crore for bio-
diesel fund;
(b) if so, which is the nodal department
to monitor this project; and
(c) how far the use of the diesel has
been found technically satisfactory in
transportation?
River Water Integration Plan
†*38. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have prepared
full outlines of River Water Integration Plan;
and
(b) the details of the plan including the
target fixed therein?
Reduction of Government’s stake in
Central PSEs
*39. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether an ad hoc group of experts
on empowerment of Central Public Sector
Enterprises has recommended that boards
of profit-making PSEs be allowed to reduce
Government stake upto 51 per cent by
raising capital from the market;
(b) if so, whether expert group has
stated that any decision to reduce
Government's equity to less than 51 per
cent in navratnas, miniratnas and public
sector enterprises with a three years profit
making record should be taken only with
the consent of the Parliament; and
(c) if so, what are the other steps
Sengupta's panel has suggested and how
its recommendations have been accepted?
Revenue earned by oil refineries
*40. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will the
Minister of  PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of petroleum refineries
both in public and in the private sector in
the country, including the products and by-
products produced by the respective units
along with installed annual capacity vis-a-
vis actual production of each item for the
last five years;
(b) the details of revenue earned by the
respective refineries from these
by-products during the period;
(c) the details of revenue, such
productions at the refineries yielded to
Government;
(d) the details of revisions of selling
prices of these by-products effected by
these refineries from time to time; and
(e) price revision on each occasion was
attributable  to what?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 20th July, 2005 Secretary-General.
